title: Sperner Lemma
body_html:
Sperner Lemma

Let $\Delta$ be a $k$-simplex with a simplicial subdivision. Suppose every vertex $v$ of the subdivision is labeled by an index belonging to the minimal face of $\Delta$ that contains $v$. Then the subdivision has an odd number of completely labeled $k$-subsimplices.

References

  • [MFoGT, Lem. 4.11.1] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory, references/MathFoundationsGameTheory.pdf. Sperner lemma for labeled subdivisions of a simplex.
